the recombinant form HORF6 expressed and crystallized from Escherichia coli and that the crystals diffract X-ray to a resolution of 2.0A.
(a) the recombinant form HORF6 expressed and crystallized from E. coli is identical to the native human protein and that (b) the crystals diffract X-ray well and have a small unit cell.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the structure determination of a novel human antioxidant protein, hORF6.
the purification, crystallization and preliminary X-Ray diffraction studies of hOR6, a novel antioxidant enzyme from humans.
the structure determination of hORF 6, which will provide the first structural data on a member of this novel family of antioxidant enzymes.

the hORF6 protein has been crystallized in a form suitable for X-ray crystallographic analysis and the structure determination is underway.

the hORF6 protein is crystallized in two different space groups and the crystals of the P21 group are suitable for the X-ray structure analysis.

we have successfully crystallized hORF6 and obtained a high-resolution native data set.
we have successfully crystallized hORF6 and have obtained a high resolution X-ray data set for the P21 space-group crystal form.

the hORF6 protein can be crystallized and that the crystals diffract X-ray to a high resolution.
